newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products all start weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all start weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products all started lower on Friday morning, dealers said.
Heating oil barges were $1 a tonne lower as IPE July gas oil futures weakened. Offer premiums were very slightly higher at IPE July +$1 fob Rotterdam, a result of the futures' slip.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded once at $84 fob Rotterdam for storage. Running refinery material was offered at $85 fob, about $1 down on Thursday's close.
Bunker demand was poor after considerable volumes yesterday.
